regime_read: The pack shows a broad risk-on tilt with government-adjacent AI/data-infrastructure names attracting unusually thick, multi-channel attention (gov-contract acceleration at PLTR, congressional and insider interest in MU, patent clusters and 13F additions across semis), while the track record is still blank so no conviction is 'measured' yet.
regime_read_zh: 数据包显示整体风险偏好偏强，政府相关的AI/数据基础设施标的吸引了异常密集的多渠道关注（PLTR 政府合同加速、MU 国会与内部人兴趣、半导体专利集群与13F加仓），但战绩记录仍为空，暂无任何'验证'级别的确信度。

theses.thesis: Micron shows the cleanest aligned buy-side read in the pack: a disclosed political affiliation via [actor:Ro Khanna], a congress cluster with net +6 flow across 3 members [congress_cluster], a perfect insider score of 100 [insider_mspr], a dense patent cluster [patent_cluster], and maximum retail bull ratio on StockTwits [stocktwits_bull]. Critically, MU is NOT extended at -10.8pp vs SPY, while 19 days to a previously positive-surprise earnings date gives a natural catalyst window [next_earnings, earnings_surprise_pct]. The only pullback channel is government grants decelerating [gov_grant_accel], which is noise relative to the insider/congress/patent alignment.
theses.thesis_zh: 美光展示了全包中最干净的看涨信号对齐：与 [actor:Ro Khanna] 的公开政治关联 [affiliation]，3位议员净+6的国会集群 [congress_cluster]，内部人分数满分100 [insider_mspr]，密集专利集群 [patent_cluster]，以及StockTwits最高的散户看涨比例 [stocktwits_bull]。关键是MU相对SPY只落后10.8个百分点，未超买，而19天后又是一个此前超预期的财报窗口 [next_earnings, earnings_surprise_pct]。唯一拖累是政府拨款减速 [gov_grant_accel]，但相对内部人/国会/专利的对齐只是噪音。
second_order: AMAT — memory and logic share the same semi equipment capex cycle, AMAT shows a patent and congress cluster with a 3-member +4 net and an unusual-options signal [patent_cluster, congress_cluster, unusual_options]

NVDA — memory demand is downstream of AI accelerator buildouts; NVDA carries the strongest convergence score (6) with Pelosi/MTG/McCaul disclosed stakes and hf-model momentum [affiliation, hf_model_momentum]
MSFT — memory and compute demand are tied to hyperscaler data-center buildouts; MSFT shows app-store demand, GitHub momentum, and a Trump-linked buy tag [app_demand, github_momentum, trump]
theses.dissent: A single-channel bull ratio of 1.0 on StockTwits is often a contrarian warning—retail is already fully positioned, and the +18.6% prior surprise may set an elevated bar for the coming print that could disappoint.

falsifier.text: MU drops below its 60-day relative low vs SPY before the 2026-09-30 earnings date, or the earnings print misses after the prior +18.6% surprise.

theses.thesis: SPCX gives the pack's clearest politically-driven read: a Congress cluster of net +8 across 4 members [congress_cluster], a 13F addition signal [13f_add], and a special-situation catalyst [special_situation], while it is badly underperforming at -23.7pp vs SPY. The thesis is a sentiment-fade recovery: four congress members bought while the name is down, so the crowded-short/left-for-dead base could reverse. Evidence is thin beyond this trio, so conviction is kept low.
theses.thesis_zh: SPCX是全包中最清晰的政治驱动标的：4位议员净+8的国会集群 [congress_cluster]，13F加仓信号 [13f_add]，以及特殊事件催化 [special_situation]，且相对SPY大跌23.7个百分点。主题是情绪反转的修复：四位议员在这个名字下跌时买入，市场遗弃的拥挤空头基础可能反转。但证据仅限于这三条，确信度保持低位。
second_order: BRK.B — value-style 13F additions pair with SPAC/theme recovery; BRK.B shows a +10 congress net across 3 members and a 13F add [13f_add, congress_cluster]
BA — special-situation patience names with government grant flow and Cramer endorsement could see short interest recycle into similar setups [gov_grant, stocktwits_bull, actor:Jim Cramer]
IEP — label-mismatch repoint from CVI flags activist value as a lagging-but-repriced theme [label_mismatches]
theses.dissent: SPCX is an ex-SPAC theme with a -23.7% relative slide and no affiliation, patent, or insider channel to confirm the read—4 congress buyers can be a slow-moving value trap rather than a catalyst.

falsifier.text: SPCX makes a new 60-day relative low vs SPY despite the congress cluster, showing the political buys were not price-validated.

theses.thesis: The label-mismatch table repoints ABTC/entity 'American Bitcoin' to HUT with 0.85 confidence, flagging that Hut 8 owns ~80% of American Bitcoin and is pivoting from crypto-mining optics to AI power/data-center infrastructure [label_mismatches]. The note cites an Anthropic/Fluidstack 245MW $7B deal, a $9.8B Beacon Point lease, and a >$16.8B pipeline—third-party factual claims from the pack, not desk-invented. HUT is not directly clustered in today's list, so this is a watch rather than an accumulate.
theses.thesis_zh: 标签错配表以0.85置信度将ABTC/实体'American Bitcoin'重定向至HUT [label_mismatches]，指出Hut 8持有American Bitcoin约80%股份，并正从加密挖矿形象转向AI电力/数据中心基础设施。注释引用了Anthropic/Fluidstack 245MW $7B协议、$9.8B Beacon Point租约和>$16.8B管线—这些都是数据包中第三方事实，并非本台自创。HUT今日清单中无直接聚类，因此是观察而非累积。
second_order: NVDA — AI data-center buildouts ultimately drive accelerator demand, and NVDA has the strongest convergence score with multiple disclosed political stakes [affiliation, hf_model_momentum]
MSFT — hyperscaler data-center and AI-power demand pairs with HUT's hosting pipeline, and MSFT carries app/GitHub momentum plus a Trump-linked buy tag [app_demand, github_momentum, trump]
PLTR — AI infra spend rides the same government-adjacent contract acceleration shown in PLTR's 2.78x gov-contract accel [gov_contract_accel]
evidence: note: ~80% ownership of American Bitcoin, exclusive infra/ops partner
note: Anthropic/Fluidstack 245MW $7B, $9.8B Beacon Point lease, >$16.8B pipeline
theses.dissent: HUT is not itself clustered in the alt-data channels today—its read rests entirely on a label-mismatch repoint and third-party deal notes, with no direct showing from congress, insider, patent, or StockTwits channels.

falsifier.text: HUT fails to hold its 60-day relative trend vs SPY while the AI-power pipeline deals named in the pack slip or are delayed.

theses.thesis: PLTR shows the strongest single-name convergence today: a 2.78x government-contract acceleration with $26.4M in 30-day awards [gov_contract_accel], an analyst upgrade cluster with a 1.0 bull ratio [analyst_upgrade_cluster], maximum retail buzz [retail_buzz, stocktwits_bull], a Trump-linked flag with a disclosed politician stake [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene, HOLDS_STAKE], and a large GitHub footprint [github_stars]. Unlike MU, PLTR's entry is worse—the name is +22.5pp vs SPY, so chasing would be an extended entry. The desk reads the alignment as a watch, not an accumulate.
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR今天展示最强的单一股票收敛：政府合同加速2.78倍、30天授予2,640万美元 [gov_contract_accel]，分析师升级集群看涨比例1.0 [analyst_upgrade_cluster]，散户热度爆表 [retail_buzz, stocktwits_bull]，以及特朗普关联标签和一位公开持股的政客 [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene, HOLDS_STAKE]。与MU不同的是，PLTR的买点更差——它已相对SPY涨22.5个百分点，追入即追高。本台将这一对齐视为观察，而非累积。
second_order: MSFT — PLTR's government AI work often rides Azure/GovCloud and enterprise AI, and MSFT shows app/GitHub momentum with a Trump-linked buy tag [app_demand, github_momentum, trump]
NVDA — AI inference and model deployment demand flows to accelerators, and NVDA has the max convergence score with Pelosi/MTG/McCaul stakes [affiliation, hf_model_momentum]
MU — data-hungry AI implementations lift memory demand, and MU is the cleanest non-extended buy in the pack [insider_mspr, patent_cluster]
evidence: actor: Marjorie Taylor Greene, HOLDS_STAKE, DISCLOSED
theses.dissent: Trump-linked flag shows a 'sell' side [trump_side: sell] and a 1.0 retail bull ratio on a name already +22.5pp vs SPY—this is the exact crowding that usually marks a local top rather than an entry.

falsifier.text: PLTR gives back its 60-day relative gains vs SPY while gov-contract acceleration cools and the retail buzz channel decays.

theses.thesis: Merck carries a Trump-linked buy tag [trump_side: buy], 11 Phase 3 starts [clinical_phase3_start], FDA label expansion [fda_label_expansion], and a special-situation flag [special_situation]. That is a quiet biotech-regulatory catalyst cluster, but MRK is +25.3pp vs SPY, so the entry is already stretched relative to its own recent move. Actionable as a watch for continued pipeline validation rather than an accumulate.
theses.thesis_zh: 默克带有特朗普关联买入标签 [trump_side: buy]，11项3期临床启动 [clinical_phase3_start]，FDA标签扩展 [fda_label_expansion]，以及特殊事件标志 [special_situation]。这是一个安静的生物医药-监管催化集群，但MRK已相对SPY涨25.3个百分点，入场已经偏高。此读法是跟踪管线验证而非累积。
second_order: ABBV — similar pharma clinical/FDA catalyst pattern in the pack, with 7 Phase 3 starts and 2 halts [clinical_phase3_start, fda_label_expansion]
Healthcare sector catalyst HR10087 — Medicare cancer-care-planning bill in the House could benefit oncology-levered pharma broadly [bill_catalysts: HR10087]
theses.dissent: Three clinical halts against 11 Phase 3 starts and a +25.3pp relative run suggest the market has already priced pipeline enthusiasm, while the Trump bio-angle is a single untracked data point.

falsifier.text: MRK underperforms SPY over the next 40 trading days despite the Phase 3 and FDA-label signals, or one of the 3 clinical halts escalates.

theses.thesis: AbbVie shows a quieter version of the MRK pattern: 7 Phase 3 starts [clinical_phase3_start], FDA label expansion [fda_label_expansion], and two material 8-K disclosures in the past month [material_8k]. It is +15.2pp vs SPY, better valued than MRK but not cheap enough to accumulate on a thin pharma-catalyst-only read. Watch for continued pipeline confirmation.
theses.thesis_zh: 艾伯维展示了一个比MRK更安静的版本：7项3期启动 [clinical_phase3_start]，FDA标签扩展 [fda_label_expansion]，以及30天内两份重大8-K披露 [material_8k]。它相对SPY涨15.2个百分点，比MRK的估值更好，但仅凭薄弱的医药催化信号还不足以累积。观察管线确认即可。
second_order: MRK — the larger Trump-linked pharma play shares FDA/pipeline momentum [trump: buy, clinical_phase3_start]
Healthcare sector catalyst HR10087 — Medicare cancer-care-planning coverage could widen pharma/oncology addressable market [bill_catalysts: HR10087]
theses.dissent: Two clinical halts and only two 8-Ks are a thin basis for an overweight, and the +15.2pp relative move suggests the FDA-label catalyst may already be partially in the price.

falsifier.text: ABBV underperforms SPY over the next 40 trading days, or the clinical-halt count ticks up above the Phase 3 start count.

theses.thesis: Microsoft shows a low-conviction but coherent government-adjacent AI read: a Trump-linked buy tag [trump_side: buy], app-store demand with massive review volume [app_demand], GitHub momentum across 191k stars and 31M downloads [github_momentum], a patent cluster [patent_cluster], and a disclosed partnership with [actor:Sam Altman] and affiliation with [actor:Bill Ackman]. The catch is the +22.8pp relative run—this is a watch, not an accumulate, because the entrance is already stretched.
theses.thesis_zh: 微软展示了一个低确信度但连贯的政府相关AI信号：特朗普关联买入标签 [trump_side: buy]，应用商店需求与海量评论 [app_demand]，GitHub动量（19.1万星、3,100万下载） [github_momentum]，专利集群 [patent_cluster]，以及与 [actor:Sam Altman] 的合作、[actor:Bill Ackman] 的关联。问题是它已相对SPY涨22.8个百分点——这是观察而非累积，因为入场已经偏高。
second_order: NVDA — Microsoft's Azure/OpenAI compute buildout is direct accelerator demand, and NVDA has 6-channel convergence with multiple politician stakes [hf_model_momentum, affiliation]
MU — hyperscaler data growth pulls memory demand, and MU is the non-extended buy in the pack [patent_cluster, insider_mspr]
PLTR — federal/enterprise AI workloads often deploy on Azure/GovCloud, linking to PLTR's gov-contract acceleration [gov_contract_accel]
theses.dissent: A +22.8pp relative move and a single buy-side flag from Trump is not enough to justify an overweight on a mega-cap that is already the most crowded AI/platform trade.

falsifier.text: MSFT yields its 60-day relative gains vs SPY while GitHub momentum and app-demand channels fade.

theses.thesis: Nvidia carries the strongest breadth of actor involvement—disclosed politician stakes from [actor:Nancy Pelosi], [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene], and [actor:Michael McCaul], plus [actor:Jensen Huang] control and [actor:Jim Cramer] chatter—with a 6-channel convergence including analyst upgrades, hf-model momentum, patent cluster, and retail buzz [affiliation, analyst_upgrade_cluster, hf_model_momentum, patent_cluster, retail_buzz, special_situation]. Yet the DPI z-score of 1.26 is only mild, and the stock has underperformed with rs_vs_spy_60d of just +2.2. The read is credible but not explosive; watch rather than accumulate.
theses.thesis_zh: 英伟达拥有全包中最广的参与者涉入—[actor:Nancy Pelosi]、[actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene]、[actor:Michael McCaul] 的公开持股，加上 [actor:Jensen Huang] 的控制权和 [actor:Jim Cramer] 的讨论—六通道收敛：分析师升级、对冲基金模型动量、专利集群和散户热度 [affiliation, analyst_upgrade_cluster, hf_model_momentum, patent_cluster, retail_buzz, special_situation]。但其DPI z-score仅有1.26，且相对SPY仅涨2.2。信号可信但不够爆发；观察而非累积。
second_order: MU — accelerator buildouts require memory supply, linking NVDA directly to MU's patent/insider cluster [insider_mspr, patent_cluster]
AMAT — advanced-packaging and equipment capex flows to AMAT, which shows congress and patent clusters [congress_cluster, patent_cluster]
MSFT — cloud AI infrastructure spend pairs with NVDA's model deployments [app_demand, github_momentum]
evidence: actor: Marjorie Taylor Greene, HOLDS_STAKE, DISCLOSED
theses.dissent: NVDA's dpi_z of 1.26 is faint, and the stock has essentially tracked SPY with only +2.2pp relative—the crowded mega-cap trade may be fully priced with little surprise left for this catalyst stack.

falsifier.text: NVDA's hf-model momentum channel goes negative while the stock underperforms SPY, showing the crowded trade is decaying.
